features.reach: GET /; renders server-side JSX with lane marker banner, last heartbeat from var/heartbeat.json, and nights on disk from runs/.
actions: Inspect lane banner and heartbeat status
Verify service liveness and active lane id

features.reach: GET /digest/<YYYY-MM-DD> (e.g. /digest/2026-10-28); reads runs/<night>.jsonl and renders rows or 404.
actions: Inspect night run rows, status, retries, and timestamps

features.reach: GET /api/digest/<YYYY-MM-DD> (e.g. /api/digest/2026-10-28); returns parsed JSON rows or 404 JSON error.
GET /watchdog (enabled unless ENABLE_ADD_VALIDATION_TESTS_AND is false/0); serves static watchdog control center HTML.
features.verify: node tools/control-rig.mjs request GET /watchdog --contains "T3 & Antigravity Self-Healing Control Center"

features.reach: GET /watchdog/api/status (enabled unless ENABLE_ADD_VALIDATION_TESTS_AND is false/0); returns watchdog snapshot and prevention primitives.
actions: Inspect active runs, anomalies, and anti-hang primitives

features.reach: Invoked offline via run_watchdog_mcp_tool({ action }) supporting status, scan_and_heal, interrupt_thread, and query_axiom.
actions: Run deterministic offline snapshot & root-cause classification smoke test
